errorAnalysis.title: Error analysis
errorAnalysis.note: Errors that are alike are one row. The analysis lives in the memory of the server node that answers: it starts again when the node restarts, and it counts only what this node saw. A quiet page is therefore not proof that nothing went wrong.
errorAnalysis.empty: No errors in this time span with these filters.
errorAnalysis.loadError: The error analysis could not be loaded.
